cards.name: 短語_雷聲隆隆作響
cards.scene: Dark storm clouds with a lightning bolt; a child at a window covering ears; big sound wave lines coming from the clouds.

cards.name: 短語_風聲呼呼作響
cards.scene: Strong wind blowing trees sideways, swirling wind lines, a child holding a hat that is about to fly off.

cards.name: 短語_樹葉沙沙作響
cards.scene: Wind blowing through a tree, leaves shaking with small sound lines, a child listening under the tree.

cards.name: 情境_鈴鐺叮叮作響
cards.scene: A child riding a bicycle and ringing the bell on the handlebar, small sound lines around the bell.

cards.name: 情境_油鍋滋滋作響
cards.scene: A mother frying an egg in a pan in the kitchen, oil bubbling and popping with sizzle lines; a child watching from a safe distance.

cards.name: 情境_肚子咕咕作響
cards.scene: A hungry child sitting in class near lunchtime, holding the tummy, little swirl sound lines near the tummy; a clock pointing near noon.

cards.name: 情境_鼓咚咚作響
cards.scene: A temple festival: a drummer hitting a big drum hard while a lion dance performs in front, big sound lines from the drum.

cards.name: 短語_爺爺是部落的傳奇獵人
cards.scene: A tall strong indigenous Bunun grandfather with a scar on his cheek, standing proudly in a mountain village, villagers looking at him with respect; mountains behind.

cards.name: 短語_媽媽是社區的美食專家
cards.scene: A mother serving delicious dishes at a neighborhood gathering, neighbors happily tasting and praising.

cards.name: 短語_姐姐是學校的風雲人物
cards.scene: A popular older sister walking through the school while many students wave and greet her.

cards.name: 短語_爸爸是公司的技術人員
cards.scene: A father in an office fixing a computer and machines, colleagues watching.

cards.name: 情境_姐姐是學校的跳繩冠軍
cards.scene: A school jump-rope contest: an older sister jumping very fast, then holding a first-place trophy, classmates cheering.

cards.name: 情境_爸爸是家裡的修理高手
cards.scene: A father with a toolbox quickly fixing a child's broken bicycle at home, the child amazed.

cards.name: 情境_小華是班上的開心果
cards.scene: A boy telling a joke in the classroom and the whole class laughing out loud.

cards.name: 情境_爺爺是公園的下棋高手
cards.scene: A grandpa playing Chinese chess at a stone table in a park, winning, with a crowd of people gathered around watching.
